Method of Attack: Out-of-bounds write vulnerability allowing remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands
Command injection attacks allowing remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands, conduct denial-of-service attacks or read arbitrary files
Discoverer: Synology's Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT)
Impacted Systems: Synology routers configured as VPN servers
Attack Vector: Remote exploitation via susceptible versions of VPN Plus Server
Command injection via WAN and LAN interfaces of Synology RT6600ax router
